brief:
Israeli occupation authorities issued halt orders Monday for work on several buildings in Issawiya village northeast of occupied Jerusalem, Shehab Wire reported. Occupation municipality crews, escorted by occupation forces, entered the village to enforce the directive.

The order marks the latest in a pattern of construction restrictions affecting the Palestinian village, where Israeli authorities have repeatedly blocked building projects and threatened demolitions of Palestinian structures.
dek: Israeli occupation authorities issued halt orders Monday for work on several buildings in Issawiya village northeast of occupied Jerusalem, Shehab Wire reported.
title: Israeli Authorities Order Work Halted on Buildings in Issawiya
